definitions.gloss: reviving someone; bringing someone round; a restorative
definitions.explanation: Bringing someone who has fainted back to consciousness, or something that does so or braces a person up, such as smelling salts or a stiff drink. Mostly met in the compounds {気付|きつ}け{薬|ぐすり} and the phrase {気付|きつ}けに.

examples.english: I gave them some water to bring them round.

examples.japanese: {気付|きつ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I had a drink to steady my nerves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気付|きつ}け{薬|ぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かがせる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: When they held smelling salts under the nose of the person who had collapsed, he soon came round.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit, consciousness) + ⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (attaching). Somewhat old-fashioned; to faint and come round are usually ⟦{気絶|きぜつ}→気絶：19929_kizetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ and ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気付|きつ}け{薬|ぐすり}: smelling salts; a restorative
- {気付|きつ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧: a drink to brace oneself

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{着付|きつ}け→着付け：33897_kitsuke⟧ (dressing in a kimono) has the same reading.
- {気付|きづけ}, read きづけ, is "care of" (c/o) in an address.
